notes.title: Release Date FAQ's
notes.notes:
[b]Release Date[/b]: April 23rd

[b]Key Bindings[/b]: I tried really hard for this guys but I would have had to reprogram the entire game. Unfortunately there are [b]no[/b] key bindings.

[b]Game Length[/b]: 2 hours of game play. Additionally a lot more if you listen to all the audio logs.

[b]Steam Deck[/b]: Yes.

[b]Wide Screen[/b]: Yes.

[b]Mouse Input[/b]: Raw.

[b]Inverted Options[/b]: Yes.

[b]Languages[/b]: Sadly though an over ambitious me thought I could get the game translated, there is so much dialogue in the game hours and hours, which would be so expensive for me to have translated. I am just a solo developer with no money and I couldn't afford to do it this time. I'm sorry guys it's only [b]English[/b].

notes.title: "Blood and Immersion" Update is live
notes.notes:
[b]All levels[/b]
Volumetric blood (blood that sprays out and lands on objects)
Added environmental story telling
Blood just like... everywhere.
Backpacks and boxes! New breakable objects giving small amount of of health and ammo.

[b]The idea was for this patch to tone back the amount of health from medical boxes, and the amount of ammo from ammo clips, and make the player "live off the land" I think this feels way more true to my original vision.[/b]

reworked visual effects
reworked textures

body decay set to 30 seconds
bodies no longer trip up or stop the players movement
